001package dev.nandi0813.api;
002
003import dev.nandi0813.api.Enum.DivisionName;
004import dev.nandi0813.api.Enum.PlayerState;
005import dev.nandi0813.api.Enum.WeightClass;
006import dev.nandi0813.api.Interface.CosmeticsRegistry;
007import dev.nandi0813.api.Interface.FFA;
008import dev.nandi0813.api.Interface.HotbarItemRegistry;
009import dev.nandi0813.api.Interface.Match;
010import dev.nandi0813.api.Interface.Party;
011import dev.nandi0813.api.Interface.Queue;
012import dev.nandi0813.api.Utilities.PlayerNametag;
013import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
014
015import java.util.List;
016
017public abstract class ZonePracticeApi
018{
019
020    /**
021     * Incremented on every additive API release. 2.4.0 = 3.
022     */
023    public static final int API_VERSION = 3;
024
025    /**
026     * Use {@link #getInstance()}. Kept for binary compatibility; set by the core plugin only.
027     */
028    @Deprecated
029    public static ZonePracticeApi instance = null;
030
031    public static ZonePracticeApi getInstance() {
032        return instance;
033    }
034
035    /**
036     * Check whether ZonePractice Pro has registered its API implementation.
037     * @return true if {@link #getInstance()} returns a non-null instance
038     */
039    public static boolean isAvailable() {
040        return instance != null;
041    }
042
043    /**
044     * Get the player's division. Main thread only.
045     * @param player The player
046     * @param divisionName Short or Full name of the division
047     * @return The player's division, or null if the player has no loaded profile
048     */
049    public abstract String getPlayerDivision(Player player, DivisionName divisionName);
050
051    /**
052     * Get the amount of unranked matches left for the player. Main thread only.
053     * @param player The player
054     * @return The amount of unranked matches left, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
055     */
056    public abstract int getPlayerUnRankedLeft(Player player);
057
058    /**
059     * Get the amount of ranked matches left for the player. Main thread only.
060     * @param player The player
061     * @return The amount of ranked matches left, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
062     */
063    public abstract int getPlayerRankedLeft(Player player);
064
065    /**
066     * Reset the player's unranked matches. Does nothing if the player has no loaded profile.
067     * Main thread only.
068     * @param player The player
069     */
070    public abstract void resetPlayerUnRanked(Player player);
071
072    /**
073     * Reset the player's ranked matches. Does nothing if the player has no loaded profile.
074     * Main thread only.
075     * @param player The player
076     */
077    public abstract void resetPlayerRanked(Player player);
078
079    /**
080     * Add unranked matches to the player. Does nothing if the player has no loaded profile.
081     * Main thread only.
082     * @param player The player
083     * @param amount The amount of unranked matches to add
084     */
085    public abstract void addPlayerUnRanked(Player player, int amount);
086
087    /**
088     * Add ranked matches to the player. Does nothing if the player has no loaded profile.
089     * Main thread only.
090     * @param player The player
091     * @param amount The amount of ranked matches to add
092     */
093    public abstract void addPlayerRanked(Player player, int amount);
094
095    /**
096     * End the match for the player. Does nothing if the player is not in a match.
097     * Main thread only.
098     * @param player The player
099     * @param endMessage The message to send to the match, in MiniMessage format. Nullable.
100     */
101    public abstract void endMatch(Player player, String endMessage);
102
103    /**
104     * Get the player's elo for a specific ladder. Main thread only.
105     * @param player The player
106     * @param ladder The ladder
107     * @return The player's elo, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile, the ladder name is unknown,
108     *         or the ladder is unranked-only
109     */
110    public abstract int getElo(Player player, String ladder);
111
112    /**
113     * Get the player's experience points. Main thread only.
114     * @param player The player
115     * @return The player's experience, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
116     */
117    public abstract int getExperience(Player player);
118
119    /**
120     * Get the player's wins for a specific weight class. Main thread only.
121     * @param player The player
122     * @param ladder The ladder
123     * @param weightClass The weight class
124     * @return The player's wins, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile or the ladder name is unknown
125     */
126    public abstract int getLadderWins(Player player, String ladder, WeightClass weightClass);
127
128    /**
129     * Get the player's losses for a specific weight class. Main thread only.
130     * @param player The player
131     * @param ladder The ladder
132     * @param weightClass The weight class
133     * @return The player's losses, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile or the ladder name is unknown
134     */
135    public abstract int getLadderLosses(Player player, String ladder, WeightClass weightClass);
136
137    /**
138     * Get the player's global wins. Main thread only.
139     * @param player The player
140     * @return The player's global wins (unranked + ranked), or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
141     */
142    public abstract int getGlobalWins(Player player);
143
144    /**
145     * Retrieves the nametag information of a given player. Main thread only.
146     *
147     * @param player The player whose nametag information is to be retrieved.
148     * @return The {@link PlayerNametag} associated with the specified player, containing
149     *         prefix, name color, and suffix components, or null if the player has no loaded profile.
150     */
151    public abstract PlayerNametag getPlayerNametag(Player player);
152
153    /**
154     * Get the player's current state. Main thread only.
155     * @param player The player
156     * @return The player's state, never null; {@link PlayerState#UNKNOWN} if the player has no loaded profile
157     */
158    public abstract PlayerState getPlayerState(Player player);
159
160    /**
161     * Get the live match the player fights in. Spectated matches are not returned. Main thread only.
162     * @param player The player
163     * @return The match, or null if the player is not fighting in a match
164     */
165    public abstract Match getMatch(Player player);
166
167    /**
168     * Get the match the player is spectating. Main thread only.
169     * @param player The player
170     * @return The spectated match, or null if the player is not spectating a match
171     */
172    public abstract Match getSpectatingMatch(Player player);
173
174    /**
175     * Get the FFA the player fights in. Main thread only.
176     * @param player The player
177     * @return The FFA, or null if the player is not fighting in an FFA
178     */
179    public abstract FFA getFfa(Player player);
180
181    /**
182     * Get the event the player is in. Main thread only.
183     * @param player The player
184     * @return The event, or null if the player is not in an event
185     */
186    public abstract dev.nandi0813.api.Interface.Event getEvent(Player player);
187
188    /**
189     * Get the party the player is in. Main thread only.
190     * @param player The player
191     * @return The party, or null if the player is not in a party
192     */
193    public abstract Party getParty(Player player);
194
195    /**
196     * Get the queue the player is in. Main thread only.
197     * @param player The player
198     * @return The queue, or null if the player is not queued
199     */
200    public abstract Queue getQueue(Player player);
201
202    /**
203     * Get the names of all enabled ladders. Main thread only.
204     * @return An unmodifiable list of ladder names, never null
205     */
206    public abstract List<String> getLadderNames();
207
208    /**
209     * Get the player's kills on a specific ladder. Main thread only.
210     * @param player The player
211     * @param ladder The ladder name
212     * @return The player's kills, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile or the ladder name is unknown
213     */
214    public abstract int getLadderKills(Player player, String ladder);
215
216    /**
217     * Get the player's deaths on a specific ladder. Main thread only.
218     * @param player The player
219     * @param ladder The ladder name
220     * @return The player's deaths, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile or the ladder name is unknown
221     */
222    public abstract int getLadderDeaths(Player player, String ladder);
223
224    /**
225     * Get the registry for addon cosmetics categories.
226     * @return The cosmetics registry, never null
227     */
228    public abstract CosmeticsRegistry getCosmeticsRegistry();
229
230    /**
231     * Get the registry for addon hotbar items.
232     * @return The hotbar item registry, never null
233     */
234    public abstract HotbarItemRegistry getHotbarItemRegistry();
235
236    /**
237     * Open the cosmetics hub for the player. Does nothing if the player has no loaded profile.
238     * Main thread only.
239     * @param player The player
240     */
241    public abstract void openCosmeticsMenu(Player player);
242
243}
